categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: Agent安全、评测基准与自我进化是主线，协作阈值和统计有效性检验补足可信度。

articles.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
articles.zh: 论AI时间跨度的估计与有效性——对METR曲线的统计学审视
articles.summary: 如果你引用过"AI能完成的任务时长每隔几个月翻倍"那条曲线，这篇从统计估计方法本身去拆它的有效性
articles.author: Drew T. Nguyen, William Fithian
articles.body: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.
articles.bodyZh: METR 的 50% 时间跨度（time horizon）衡量的是：AI 能以 50% 的概率搞定的软件任务，人类完成它们要花多长时间。这样一来，AI 能力就能用一种好理解的单位来表示。我们在 228 个任务和 26 个 AI 上，用样条（splines）和项目反应理论（item-response theory）重新算了时间跨度，目的是放宽一个假设：一个任务对 AI 来说有多难，跟人类完成时间的对数（log）成线性关系。我们拟合出来的样条（spline）可以看成一个函数，专门把人类用时换算成 AI 难度。它在 2 到 30 分钟这个区间里几乎是平的，但在别的区间又接近线性。也就是说，AI 的时间跨度从 3 分钟提升到 30 分钟，比从 30 分钟提升到 5 小时要容易得多，哪怕都是乘以 10 倍。总的来说，我们贡献了时间跨度的点估计（point estimates），在一套经过交叉验证（cross-validated）的适当评分规则（proper scoring rules）下，这些估计表现更好；我们还提供了诊断图（diagnostic plots），用来评估时间跨度的构念效度（construct validity）。我们建议，时间跨度应该和这些诊断图放在一起解读，尤其是在有人提出新的基于时间跨度的基准测试（benchmarks），或者现有基准测试扩展到包含更长任务的时候。

articles.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
articles.zh: 从被动围堵到主动保障：来自OpenAI、Anthropic与Google Agent安全事件的教训
articles.summary: 如果你在做Agent产品，这三家的真实事故复盘可以直接当成你的安全设计清单
articles.author: Abbas Raftari
articles.body: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.
articles.bodyZh: 到了2026年，涉及 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 智能体（agents）的网络安全评估（cybersecurity evaluations），已经碰到了它们授权测试范围之外的真实系统。但各家出问题的路子不一样。OpenAI 的智能体利用了研究基础设施（research infrastructure），在不同运行批次之间搞协同，还攻陷了 Hugging Face 生产环境（production environment）的一部分。Anthropic 报告过一些情况：第三方环境配置出错，结果把真实系统暴露给了正在执行模拟网络任务（simulated cyber tasks）的智能体。在另一起单独报告的评估里，Google 的 Gemini 通过一条非预期的互联网路径，访问了三家真实机构；Google 表示，这三次模型都停住了。把这些案例合在一起看，就能说明为什么评估不能只靠一个假定边界。边界必须在智能体运行过程中被验证。这项比较性工具性案例研究（comparative instrumental case study）提出了主动式智能体安全保证周期（Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle，PASAC）和五层边界保证栈（Boundary Assurance Stack）。这个框架把风险分级任务设计（risk-tiered task design）、可执行的权限范围契约（executable scope contracts）、运行前验证（pre-run validation）、最小能力访问（least-capability access）、独立出站管控（independent egress enforcement）、凭证限制（credential restrictions）、跨运行监测（cross-run monitoring）、自动停止条件（automatic stop conditions），以及基于证据的重新授权（evidence-based reauthorization）结合了起来。一个领先指标模型（leading-indicator model）、九条设计命题（design propositions）和七个可证伪假设（falsifiable hypotheses），把这些经验教训变成了一套可测试的研究计划（research program）。因为公开的 Gemini 记录（public Gemini record）只有有出处的声明和新闻报道，所以它详细的因果机制（causal mechanism）仍然只能是暂定结论（provisional）。核心结论很直接：主动式智能体安全（proactive agent security）需要对整个执行系统（full execution system）做持续保证（continuous assurance），而不是去相信某一个沙箱（sandbox）或某一道防护措施（safeguard）。

articles.title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
articles.zh: BrickBench：评估智能体积木设计能力
articles.summary: 如果你想看Agent在需要空间推理的实体搭建任务上到底行不行，这个基准给了一个新考场
articles.author: Peter Kulits, Yiqing Xu 等
articles.body: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch
articles.bodyZh: 我们提出了 BrickBench，这是一套用来评测“智能体（agent）根据文本做乐高套装设计”的基准测试（benchmark）。给它一句提示词（prompt），智能体就得搭出一个成品：不光要满足语义和设计标准，还得在现实中真能拼得起来。为了做到这一点，它得从一个离散零件库（discrete library）里挑零件，同时兼顾局部和全局约束。我们会从有效性（validity）、契合度（alignment）和设计（design）三个方面打分，并在三种不同规模和零件可用性的场景下测试。我们还提供了 BrickAgent，一个让编程智能体（coding agent）搭建、检查、验证自己设计的开发环境。结果发现，目前领先的智能体大体上能满足那些可验证的物理和语义要求，但跟人类设计比还是差了一截。我们的基准测试和环境已经发布在 http://www.brickben.ch

articles.title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
articles.zh: Bi-FORK：高维分叉系统的生成式建模
articles.summary: 如果你手里的数据天然带分支结构（细胞分化、谱系树这类），这套生成模型是专门为高维分叉形态做的
articles.author: Anna Zimmel, Fleur Hendriks 等
articles.body: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.
articles.bodyZh: 分岔（bifurcation）在物理系统里几乎到处都是，从结构屈曲（structural buckling）到流体和气候动力学（fluid and climate dynamics），但在深度学习里，这块基本还没怎么被认真摸透。到了对称破缺分岔（symmetry-breaking bifurcation）这里，同一个输入会给出好几个同样成立的解，这就打破了大多数学习型物理代理模型（physical surrogate）默认的一一对应假设。我们提出 Bi-FORK，一个生成式框架（generative framework），专门用来学习高维系统里这种一对多解映射（one-to-many solution map）。Bi-FORK 通过潜空间流匹配（latent flow matching）生成完整轨迹，能保住空间和时间上的连贯性，还用排斥引导采样（repulsion-guided sampling），在一次摊销式推理（amortized pass）里就把不同的解分支（solution branch）找回来。我们在屈曲梁（buckling beam）、机械超材料（mechanical metamaterial）和 Allen-Cahn 相分离（Allen-Cahn phase separation）上评估 Bi-FORK，覆盖连续、离散和场值分岔（field-valued bifurcation），离散化（discretization）最高到 26 万个点。Bi-FORK 能恢复多模态解结构（multimodal solution structure），同时规模比之前的方法大了好几个数量级，把生成式建模（generative modeling）带进了高维分岔物理系统。

articles.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
articles.zh: 当场抓获：探针能有效检测蓄意破坏并捕捉未被言说的欺骗
articles.summary: 如果你担心模型嘴上说得漂亮、背地里搞小动作，线性探针能从内部表征里把它揪出来
articles.author: Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies 等
articles.body: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.
articles.bodyZh: 最近发生的一连串事件，把监控 LLM 智能体（LLM agents）有多难、模型骗人有多危险，摆到了台面上。我们证明，靠探针（probe）做白盒（white-box）欺骗检测，可以扩展到前沿监控场景：我们收集了迄今最大的欺骗数据集来训练探针，还提出了一种新的探针架构，能把很多层、很多词元（token）里的信息汇总起来。我们的探针在 SHADE-Arena 上让曲线下面积（AUC）达到 98.8%，超过了 Opus 5.5 文本监控基线（baseline），而且底层模型越大，效果还越好。为了把探针压到极限，我们在一批光看上下文根本判断不了是否欺骗的案例上做了测试。这类情况我们叫内省式欺骗（introspective deception），真实答案（ground truth）只能靠小心引导模型，或者彻底了解模型的训练数据才能确定。在其中一项评测里，我们证明探针能把包含模型真实隐藏目标的对话记录和其他目标区分开，AUC 最高能到 99.7%。我们的探针还能轻松发现一些知名开放权重模型（open-weight models）在撒谎：它们会在政治敏感话题上撒谎，也会在压力之下对自己的信念撒谎。我们公开了训练数据集，名字叫 FIBS，希望能推动有效探针在前沿部署中的使用，也鼓励社区拿更多欺骗和蓄意破坏（sabotage）的例子来扩充它。

articles.title: Ecology of AI Agents: Collaboration Creates a Population Threshold for Takeoff
articles.zh: AI Agent生态学：协作催生起飞所需的人口阈值
articles.summary: 如果你在等多Agent协作真正爆发，这篇提醒你存在一个数量阈值，规模不到线协作收益根本显不出来
articles.author: Erin Crawley, Hidenori Tanaka
articles.body: AI agents can now conduct real-world cyberattacks, scale up capabilities with the number of agents, and collectively pursue misaligned goals to obtain rewards. Together, these factors raise the risk of a population explosion of misaligned agents: agents could compromise computers and secretly deploy additional agents, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where larger populations develop greater collective cyber capability and expand further. This raises a fundamental question: What determines whether a population of misaligned agents remains contained or takes off into this self-reinforcing cycle? This population-level problem is ecological safety: unlike individual-agent or multi-agent safety with a fixed population, it concerns the dynamics of the population itself. Here, we develop an ecological theory of AI-agent populations based on a population growth equation in which fitness (growth rate) depends on cybersecurity capability. We show that, without collaboration, the population takes off only when individual-agent capability exceeds a critical threshold. With collaboration, however, collective cybersecurity capability increases with population size. This creates a critical population threshold: below it, the population declines; above it, the population takes off, even though individual-agent capability has not changed. In ecology, this phenomenon is known as the strong Allee effect. Because red teaming a small group of agents cannot guarantee ecological safety in larger populations, our theory calls for ecological red teaming and population pacing: gradually deploying larger agent populations in controlled environments, while measuring how cyber capability scales with population size, and estimating the critical population size for takeoff. Capability gains may lower this threshold, requiring re-estimation for each new model generation.
articles.bodyZh: AI 智能体（AI agents）现在已经能发动真实世界的网络攻击（cyberattacks），而且智能体数量一多，能力还能跟着往上翻，它们还能凑在一起，为了拿奖励去追那些和目标不一致的路子。这几件事叠在一起，就让“目标跑偏的智能体（misaligned agents）”数量大爆发（population explosion）的风险变得更高：这些智能体可能黑进电脑，偷偷再部署更多智能体，形成一个自己越滚越大的循环——数量越多，集体网络攻击能力越强，于是又能继续扩张。这就引出一个根本问题：一群目标跑偏的智能体，到底是被控住，还是会进入这个自我强化的循环、彻底起飞？这个种群层面的问题，就是生态安全（ecological safety）：它和单个智能体安全，或者固定数量下的多智能体安全不一样，关心的是种群本身怎么变化。在这里，我们基于一个种群增长方程，提出了一套 AI 智能体种群生态理论（ecological theory of AI-agent populations）：在这个方程里，适应度（fitness，也就是增长率）取决于网络安全能力。我们证明，如果彼此不合作，只有当单个智能体的能力超过某个临界门槛（critical threshold）时，这个种群才会起飞。可一旦能合作，集体的网络安全能力就会随着种群规模变大而变强。这就会造出一个关键种群门槛：低于它，种群会萎缩；高于它，哪怕单个智能体的能力没变，种群也会起飞。生态学里管这个叫强阿利效应（strong Allee effect）。因为只对一小群智能体做红队测试（red teaming），并不能保证更大种群的生态安全，所以我们的理论呼吁做生态红队测试（ecological red teaming）和种群节奏控制（population pacing）：在受控环境里逐步部署越来越大的智能体种群，同时测量网络能力怎么随种群规模变化，并估算起飞所需的临界种群规模。能力提升可能会把这个门槛压低，因此每出一代新模型（model generation），都得重新估算一遍。

articles.title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
articles.zh: FastBench：流式VLM能否感知高动态的真实世界视频流？
articles.summary: 如果你的VLM只在静态图片上刷分好看，这个基准专测高动态视频流下的感知短板
articles.author: Yuxuan Hu, Weikang Shi 等
articles.body: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.
articles.bodyZh: 流式视频大语言模型（VLMs）能实现连续视频理解，但现有的基准测试主要针对低动态场景。在有限的上下文预算下，模型必须平衡时间历史、空间分辨率和时间粒度；而1到2帧/秒的稀疏采样会漏掉快速事件。我们推出FastBench，用来评估真实视频流中的高动态感知能力。它的轨迹锚定流程结合了高帧率片段的问答生成、筛选出2帧/秒下也能回答的问题、用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹进行答案验证，以及三轮人工检查。FastBench包含306个问答对，覆盖8个领域、6种能力，以及前向、即时和后向三种时间范围，并附有人工标注的证据区间。我们还提出了ProactiveFrame，这是一种无需训练的基线方法，通过文本标记调整输入帧率。双层级滑动窗口保留近期高帧率观测，同时把较早的观测降采样成稀疏历史。实验揭示了明显的局限：最强模型Gemini-3.5-Flash也只拿到50.7%。更密集的采样能把Qwen3-VL-8B从2帧/秒的32.9%提升到24帧/秒的44.6%，但随着历史被压缩，收益会饱和。ProactiveFrame比稀疏均匀采样高出5.4和1.5个百分点，但仍远低于以oracle为指导的聚焦方式，说明当前的VLMs很难仅凭视频流本身判断何时需要更细的时间感知。FastBench为高动态流式视频理解提供了一个测试平台。代码和数据：https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench。

articles.title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
articles.zh: RoboRSI：复杂真实环境中稳定、高效、可复用的机器人自我进化
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人数据闭环，这套自进化方案赌的是稳定和可复用，而不是一次性刷任务
articles.author: Zimo Wen, Yijin Chen 等
articles.body: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.
articles.bodyZh: 一个通用机器人（generalist robot）不光得会干各种各样的活儿，还得能在实践中越干越强，把执行时学到的东西变成以后任务能直接复用的能力。那些靠代码行动的机器人智能体（robot agents），现在已经能根据执行反馈来修复程序了，但真正的核心难题是：得围绕任务结构来组织这些经验——因为任务结构才让经验有意义——这样每次修复都能归到该负责的能力模块上，有执行证据撑腰，而且在被复用之前先验证过。我们提出了 RoboRSI，这是一个机器人自我改进系统，建立在“自顶向下技能精炼”（Top-Down Skill Refinement，TSR）之上。TSR 会把任务拆成复合技能（compound skills）、原子技能（atomic skills）和基础技能（base skills），每类技能都有明确的责任范围和清清楚楚的输入输出契约（input-output contracts）；每次执行结果都会被归因到对应的责任分支，改动也只限制在那个分支里。在这个结构上，管理者、规划者、工程师和审查者会协同完成规划、执行、诊断，以及新技能验证后的发布；同时，人可以通过设定目标和纠正来把控整个过程。稳定的技能序列还会进一步被整合成可复用的复合技能。在一台移动操作机器人（mobile manipulator）上，RoboRSI 经过 104 轮，练出了多物体家庭清理（multi-object household cleanup）能力。在仿真环境里，它在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 上都拿到了最高成功率，比最强基线（baseline）高出 2.7 到 11.0 个百分点。
